title: Cineverse Launches New 'So … Real' SVOD Channel on Roku
summary: Cineverse (Nasdaq: CNVS), an entertainment technology company and studio, has announced today the addition of two new subscription video-on-demand (SVOD) channels available via Premium Subscriptions on The Roku Channel. The two new subscription offerings are So … Real , Cineverse's channel dedicated to lifestyle and reality content from All3Media International, and Cineverse , the company's flagship streaming brand that features series and movies for any mood. This marks the SVOD launch of So … Real, previously available as a free, ad-supported streaming television (FAST) channel, and the expansion of Cineverse, which has grown since launching its SVOD offering. Roku customers can watch the following and more on So … Real with a Premium Subscription: The Only Way is Essex – A glamorous series with big characters - the 'love rat', the 'bitch', the 'tart with a heart', the 'camp' gossip - but all of them are playing themselves, all of them living in the golden triangle of Essex,
